Joseph Bernstein / New York Times :

 GTA VI's 5,000-strong team eschewed AI and procedural generation in favor of handcrafted “fidelity”, with 30,000 unique NPCs and an in-game video game system   —  A few months ago, when I started to brag to people that I might be getting an advance copy of Grand Theft Auto VI …
